correctness.rationale: A nonempty column intersects only one occupied component, and adjacent column masks intersect precisely when that component continues. Parity is forced from each finite left end and is freely initialized on an infinite-left component to satisfy any right closure. The primitive right-resolving graph has at most seven lifts per finite word, justifying the entropy retained as context. For an n-periodic marked word containing a break, each occupied component is finite and there is exactly one n-closed lift iff the word is admissible. With no break the single occupied component is bilateral and admissible; it has 2 lifts when the singleton count is even and 0 otherwise (including n=1). The signed trace of W is exactly the excess; the formal trace determinant identity yields the stated quotient. Independently counted components in an n-column quotient graph using integer displacement consistency to distinguish winding components, and checked both characteristic polynomials exactly. Periods 1–8 gave 4,14,40,158,514,1844,6374,22446. Replay: python3 /workspace/branches/independent_reproduction.py 4 (SymPy).
residual_risks: Finite reproduction is not the all-period argument or a formal proof certificate.
